description: This file defines the LinkMetadata struct and related functions for handling link metadata, including OpenGraph data and images, in the Mattermost project.

classes.name: LinkMetadata
classes.description: Struct representing metadata about a link, including URL, timestamp, type, and associated data.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Computes and sets the hash for the LinkMetadata before saving.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the LinkMetadata object, ensuring URL, timestamp, and data types are correct.

methods.name: DeserializeDataToConcreteType
methods.description: Converts the Data field from JSON into its concrete type based on the LinkMetadataType.
